subject: Request: Pilot onboarding without PO — SolarisAI
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@solarisai.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Turner <ben.turner@solarisai.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot onboarding: request no-PO path for 90-day pilot

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — excited to get SolarisAI into a short pilot with Redwood Inference. We’re planning a 90-day evaluation (internal team + 2 external customers) to validate latency and cost for our use case. Expected spend during the pilot is approximately $6k–$9k total, billed monthly.

Because this is a short, time-sensitive trial, procurement at SolarisAI asked whether Redwood can accept invoice-only billing / onboarding without a formal PO for this initial period. We’ve completed the vendor onboarding form (attached) and included a PDF with our company bank statement and incorporation docs. If Redwood requires any additional paperwork (W-9, SOC details), we can provide them ASAP.

Key asks:
- Temporary onboarding without PO for 90-day pilot (invoices on 30-day net terms)
- Point of contact for legal/finance to sign any short-term agreement or acknowledge the pilot terms

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB), solarisai-evidence-acct-statement.pdf (application/pdf, 80 KB)

Thanks — Ben and I are available for a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Alyssa Greene
Head of Growth, SolarisAI
alyssa@solarisai.com
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Greene <alyssa@solarisai.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-19T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: request no-PO path for 90-day pilot

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the details and for sending the form. Happy to get this moving. A few clarifying items from our side to speed internal approvals:

1) Confirm estimated pilot spend per month (you noted $6k–$9k total; is that ~$2k–3k/mo?)
2) Billing entity and remit-to address (as it should appear on invoices)
3) Who on your legal/finance side can receive a short acknowledgement (we sometimes use a one-page pilot addendum)

For transparency: our Procurement/Finance teams allow temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under $10k total if the vendor profile includes required evidence (incorporation, bank info, tax docs) and a named billing contact. The approval path usually requires a procurement approver and a Finance review.

If you can confirm the above items, I’ll loop in Procurement (Priyom) and Finance (Marissa) to request a conditional approval. If it helps, we can put a temporary spend cap and tag invoices to a pilot cost center so this stays isolated.

Would you be available for a 20-minute sync tomorrow morning?

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: request no-PO path for 90-day pilot

Jonas / Marissa — reviewed SolarisAI’s onboarding form and the evidence Alyssa attached. Quick summary and proposed conditions to mitigate AP/Procurement risk for a temporary invoice-only path:

- Estimated pilot spend: $2,500–$3,000 per month (total ~$7k).
- Documents received: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, bank statement + incorporation PDFs. Missing: completed W-9 (US tax form) — request that from Alyssa before first invoice.

Proposed conditional approval (subject to Finance sign-off):
1) Invoice-only onboarding for a single 90-day pilot (max cumulative spend $10,000).
2) SolarisAI to submit a completed W-9 before first invoice; invoices to be marked "Pilot - DL-3821" and routed to AP with code PILOT-3821.
3) Payment terms: Net 30. No long-term contract implied by this pilot approval.
4) Procurement will re-evaluate before any renewal or expansion; any longer engagement must follow standard PO process.

If Finance (Marissa/Rishi) agrees, I’ll create the conditional evidence record and update the vendor profile with the temporary authorization. Please confirm whether we should require a pilot addendum signed by SolarisAI legal (I recommend a short one-page acknowledgement to avoid ambiguity).

On Fri, Jun 19, 2027 at 09:12 Alyssa Greene <alyssa@solarisai.com> wrote:
> Hope you’re well — excited to get SolarisAI into a short pilot with Redwood Inference...

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa@solarisai.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onboarding: request no-PO path for 90-day pilot

Thanks for the note and the clear proposed conditions, Priyom. Finance is comfortable with a conditional invoice-only onboarding for SolarisAI with the following minor edits:

- Require completed W-9 before the first invoice is paid.
- Add explicit spend alert at $8,000 (AP to notify Procurement and the Sales owner when cumulative invoices reach $8k).
- Invoices must include the text: "Pilot only — no implied renewal or obligation; contact jonas_weber@redwood.com for changes."

Jonas — please send the short pilot addendum (one page) to Alyssa for signature and have SolarisAI return the signed copy prior to first invoice. Alyssa — once we receive the W-9 and the signed addendum we’ll provision the vendor as invoice-only under the PILOT-3821 code. AP will route payments per Net 30.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (application/pdf, 120 KB)
